name: RAPP Voice
summary: Hold a key anywhere on macOS, speak, release, and cleaned-up text appears at your cursor. Speech recognition runs on-device via whisper.cpp; your voice never leaves the machine. Filler stripping, app-aware formatting and a weighted personal dictionary.
tagline: Hold a key anywhere on macOS, speak, release, and cleaned-up text appears at your cursor.
egg_note: The copy of this manifest inside the .egg describes a hatch cartridge: it carries twin/ and state/ only. `agent` and `ui` are bundle-relative paths that live in the source repo, not in the egg — the twin loads twin/agents/, not singleton/.
